items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: Did you ever play with any of those fellas? Richard Brunus, Henry Brunus? No, never did.

ctx.x: Do you remember uh Fisher's band? It was a band run by I think it was Johnny Fisher. Do you remember, I think that was uptown, that might have been in the Irish channel up that way. Maybe so. Fisher, do you remember hearing him? No. Did you ever know any of the Brunus family? Brunus.
Brunus. Up there in the Irish channel? Yeah. Well they, they had a band I believe of Brunus.

Did you ever play with any of those fellas? Richard Brunus, Henry Brunus? No, never did. I wondered uh Happy Schilling, do you remember Happy Schilling, a trombone player? No, I don't remember him either. He was uptown too. And uh Tom Brown, do you remember Tom Brown?
